text.text: Hurrican is a freeware action platform game inspired by the classic Turrican series of games. Released in 2007, it combines side-scrolling platforming, shooting, exploration, and upgrade-based gameplay in a modern fan-made interpretation of the genre. The game features multiple weapons, large levels, boss battles, and detailed pixel-based graphics. Hurrican became known as a tribute to the original Turrican games while adding new content and modern PC features.
